[APPENDIX] Rules on the Imposition of Anti-Dumping Duties on Plywood Originating in Vietnam [Table]

Anti-Dumping Duty Rates by Supplier of Goods Subject to Duties (Related to Article 3)

Country of supply: Vietnam.

| Category of supplier | Anti-dumping duty rate (%) |
|---|---:|
| 1. SAVI CO. LTD and persons exporting its products | 23.74 |
| 2. Thanh Hung Import-Export Company Limited and persons exporting its products | 9.80 |
| 3. Junma Phu Tho Company Limited and persons exporting its products | 31.28 |
| 4. Cong Ty Tnhh Mot Thanh Vien Kieu Thi Junma and persons exporting its products | 31.28 |
| 5. Yen Bai Wood Industry Company Limited and persons exporting its products | 9.78 |
| 6. Rongjia Woods Vietnam Company Limited and persons exporting its products | 31.28 |
| 7. The following companies and persons exporting their products: (a) TTTK Co. Ltd; (b) TTTK Thai Nguyen Co. Ltd; (c) TTTK Trading Co. Ltd | 11.46 |
| 8. All other suppliers | 13.94 |

Note: Where a supplier under subparagraph 8 has a special relationship, as prescribed in Article 23 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Customs Act, with a supplier under any of subparagraphs 1 through 7, the anti-dumping duty rate applicable to the supplier under subparagraphs 1 through 7 with which it has that relationship shall apply, notwithstanding the rate applicable to a supplier under subparagraph 8.
